program.title: BSc in Physics
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-4, 4-6, 4-7, 3-6).

The IRE Track and the two options (Honors Physics, Physics and Mathematics) are additional/alternative requirements; they are optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'), and their credits are included in the calculated total, but a student would follow only one of them.

Many blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. PHYS 3033/3053, PHYS 3036/3037, capstone alternatives, MATH blocks), and several alternatives carry track/option restrictions, so actual credits may differ.
The Physics Electives list also allows 'Any PHYS courses at 3000-level or above' beyond the explicitly listed courses, so the recorded elective course list is not exhaustive.
Remarks in the PDF note that MATH 1012 and PHYS 4813 were last offered in earlier years and subsequently deleted; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 PHYS (4Y) (2023-24 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2023-24 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2023-24 per the intake year.
